data.title: Breakers
data.description:
Joo In-gong was dragged into the remake of a game he was playing called .

However, something wasn't right. The only playable characters should be Loch of the human side and Zephyr of the demon side. Instead, he awakens in the body of Shutra— the ninth prince of the Demon Realm, a character who actually didn't exist in the game’s story.

Granted two mysterious powers, "Protagonist Setting Adjustment" and "Power of Conquest," Joo In-gong now must alter the game's plot to survive against Zephyr.

Yet, with every twist of the plot, he garners more attention...
data.author: Chwiryong

data.description:
The launch of the virtual reality game Warlord in the year 2035 changed the world.

Ahn Jaehyun was one of many who sought to change his fate within it.

But the price of devoting his entire life to the game was betrayal by the very comrades he trusted the most.

Having lost everything because of that betrayal, Jaehyun is given one more chance to start over.

"I'm never playing with others again. Whether I win or lose, I'll do it all on my own, and show them exactly what that means."

While others roll dice to split the loot, Jaehyun is the one who takes it all for himself.

And so begins his thrilling, ruthless, solo-kill gaming life!

"My revenge won’t end until every Demon in this world has been wiped out.”

After brutally displaying the head of the Demon that murdered his parents, the boy Yise was shunned by his village as a monster.

Having lost all attachment to life, Yise encountered Mongryeon—a dokkaebi who hunted Demons—and found a new purpose: to exterminate every Demon in existence.

That was when his life alongside Mongryeon began. But as they traveled together, Mongryeon discovered that there was something extraordinary about Yise.

For his sake, Mongryeon sent Yise to the Grand Martial Path, a cultivation sect known as the immortal realm’s executioners.

And so began the tale of the boy who walked the path of cultivation to bring about the extinction of Demons.

data.description:
By Redice Studio that brought you <Myst, Might, Mayhem> and <Nano Machine>, <Reaper of the Drifting Moon>, and many more!]


Jin Sowoon, a third-rate warrior who remembers everything, regresses to thirty years before the Demonic Cult’s return.

"The fact that I’ve come back to the past doesn’t exactly feel like a sign telling me to save the world."

“If that were the case, shouldn’t they have at least given me some special ability, or stuck me with the soul of Zhang Sanfeng or something like that?”

His sect is a hopeless third-rate school.

His talent for martial arts is as lowly as it gets.

It’s hard for him to celebrate returning when the hand he’s been dealt is this weak.

“I’m screwed.”

And so begins Jin Sowoon’s desperate struggle to change a future already doomed to despair.
data.author: Jeokseolmok
